howToApply: Visit the official website: bceceboard.bihar.gov.in and click on the ‘Online Portal of Senior Resident / Tutor under Health Dept.’ link.
Click on ‘Apply for Senior Resident / Tutor’ link, then click the ‘New Registration’ button.

Step-One (Registration): Fill all information correctly in the Online Application Form. Use your own or parent’s email address and mobile number. Verify the mobile number and email address using the verification code sent to them.

Step-Two (Multi-Step Application Form): After registration, Sign In and complete: (a) Department Selection, (b) Personal Information, (c) Contact Details, (d) Educational Information, (e) Upload Photo & Signature. Click ‘Save & Continue’ after each step.

Step-Three (Application Preview & Final Submit): Review all entries. If any anomaly found, click ‘Back to Edit’ and rectify. After verification, click ‘Final Submit & Proceed to Payment’ and pay the Counselling Fee.
Step-Four (Payment of Counselling Fee): Pay Rs. 2250/- through Online mode only (Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI). Processing charges are additional.
Step-Five (Download Confirmation Page & Fee Receipt): After successful payment, download the Confirmation Page & Fee Receipt and re-verify entries. Download the Confirmation Page for future use.
Hard copy of Application Form need not be sent to the Board’s office but must be produced at the time of counselling.
